rows.note: For physical location, this is the all-purpose everyday way to say that something is inside A.

example.english: I’m looking for my book within the room.
example.traditional: 我喺間房入面搵緊本書。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 gaan1 fong2 jap6 min6 wan2 gan2 bun2 syu1

rows.note: Use this for being within a stated time limit or other bounded scope, such as within three days.

example.english: We’ll get back to you within three days.
example.traditional: 我哋會喺三日內覆返你。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wui5 hai2 saam1 jat6 noi6 fuk1 faan1 nei5

rows.note: Use this specifically when within means inside a range or scope, including what someone can hear.

example.english: This signal is within my phone’s reception range.
example.traditional: 呢個訊號喺我部手機嘅接收範圍內。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 seon3 hou6 hai2 ngo5 bou6 sau2 gei1 ge3 zip3 sau1 faan6 wai4 noi6

rows.note: Use this when “within” means close to a limit: only A separated the subject from doing V.

example.english: I was within one second of being late.
example.jyutping: ngo5 caa1 jat1 miu5 zau6 ci4 dou3 laa3
